data.title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
data.description: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.
